tokens.npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit_bio: Even the most contented Skywrath is an ill-tempered creature, naturally inclined to seek revenge for the slightest insult. But Vengeful Spirit is the essence of vengeance. Once a proud and savage Skywrath scion, Shendelzare was first in succession for the Ghastly Eyrie until a sister's treachery robbed her of her birthright. Snared in an assassin's net, Shendelzare tore free only at the cost of her wings, limping away in the ultimate humiliation: On foot. With her wings broken, she knew the Skywrath would never accept her as ruler; and in the highest roost of the Eyrie, inaccessible except by winged flight, her sister was untouchable. Unwilling to live as a flightless cripple, and desiring revenge far more than earthly power, the fallen princess drove a bargain with the goddess Scree'Auk: She surrendered her broken body for an imperishable form of spirit energy, driven by vengeance, capable of doing great damage in the material plane. She may spend eternity flightless, but she will have her revenge.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit_hype: Vengeful Spirit's presence is felt at all times, whether she is alive or dead. Able to swap positions with any nearby hero, stun enemies, and reduce her killer's effectiveness if she falls, she constantly brings confusion and chaos to her foes.

But Vengeful Spirit is the essence of vengeance. Once a proud and savage Skywrath scion, Shendelzare was first in succession for the Ghastly Eyrie until a sister's treachery robbed her of her birthright. Snared in an assassin's net, Shendelzare tore free only at the cost of her wings, limping away in the ultimate humiliation: On foot. With her wings broken, she knew the Skywrath would never accept her as ruler; and in the highest roost of the Eyrie, inaccessible except by winged flight, her sister was untouchable. Unwilling to live as a flightless cripple, and desiring revenge far more than earthly power, the fallen princess drove a bargain with the goddess Scree'Auk: She surrendered her broken body for an imperishable form of spirit energy, driven by vengeance, capable of doing great damage in the material plane. She may spend eternity flightless, but she will have her revenge.

qualifications.raw: The Vengeance Aura is more effective on Shen and her Vengeance Illusion.

Upon her death, Shen leaves behind an illusion that can cast all of her abilities. Experience gain by the illusion is granted to Shen.

If the Vengeance Illusion is alive while she respawns, she assumes its place.

The Vengeance Illusion is a strong illusion that deals and receives as much damage as Shen.

Utilizes Shen's current vision range, and has full health and mana upon creation.

* {{Symbol|Aura}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
** Grants flat {{M|bonus attack damage}} corresponding to the affected allied unit's {{M|main attack damage}}.
** Affects the following units:
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Hidden}} units.
<hr>
{{Illucraft
| t = 2
| name = Vengeful Spirit Vengeance Aura
| desc = for everyone}}

* {{cf|aghnotes}} Adds two passive components to the ability.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Illusions|Strong}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}}
*** Creates {{ValueColor||{{#var:Vengeance Aura type2 value1 agh}}|agh}} [[strong illusion]] corresponding to Shen's [[facing angle]], {{ValueColor||108|agh}}-distance at Shen's {{M|death}} location with the following summoned direction sequence:
**** [[File:Dota2 South.png|31px|South]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px|East]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 North.png|31px|North]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 West.png|31px|West]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 South.png|31px|South]]
*** Has the following additional properties:
**** All current {{M|cooldowns}} are transfered to the Vengeance Illusion.
***** However, it cannot cast item abilities.
**** Utilizes the hero {{M|health|text=health bar}}.
**** Does not have the {{M|illusion}} {{M|vision}} penalty.
**** Neither has a {{M|gold}} nor {{M|experience}} bounty.
**** Not affected by certain {{M|instant kill}} sources.
**** {{A|Enchantress|Enchant}} considers the Vengeance Illusion as heroes.
**** Has the following illusion duration properties:
***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|MAX Duration {{=}} [[Death#Respawn Time|RespawnTime]]}}
***** The {{M|buyback}} [[Heroes/Mechanics#Buyback|next respawn time]] increase does not affect the illusion max duration.
*** {{M|Instant kills}} the Vengeance illusion in the following conditions:
**** Once Shen respawns.
**** When the illusion reaches its normal expire duration.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit
data.bio_loc: Even the most contented Skywrath is an ill-tempered creature, naturally inclined to seek revenge for the slightest insult. But Vengeful Spirit is the essence of vengeance. Once a proud and savage Skywrath scion, Shendelzare was first in succession for the Ghastly Eyrie until a sister's treachery robbed her of her birthright. Snared in an assassin's net, Shendelzare tore free only at the cost of her wings, limping away in the ultimate humiliation: On foot. With her wings broken, she knew the Skywrath would never accept her as ruler; and in the highest roost of the Eyrie, inaccessible except by winged flight, her sister was untouchable. Unwilling to live as a flightless cripple, and desiring revenge far more than earthly power, the fallen princess drove a bargain with the goddess Scree'Auk: She surrendered her broken body for an imperishable form of spirit energy, driven by vengeance, capable of doing great damage in the material plane. She may spend eternity flightless, but she will have her revenge.
data.hype_loc: Vengeful Spirit's presence is felt at all times, whether she is alive or dead. Able to swap positions with any nearby hero, stun enemies, and reduce her killer's effectiveness if she falls, she constantly brings confusion and chaos to her foes.
data.npe_desc_loc: Can swap herself with any nearby hero
